configurations.name: verdict-api-free
configurations.//: The API with the LLM path off: agents degrade to the deterministic autopilot (rule 11) and chat answers deterministically. Blanks the key rather than unsetting it, because backend/__init__ calls load_dotenv(override=False) and an unset variable is simply reloaded from .env — that is bug #9. Sets the env BEFORE importing backend, which is the same reason.
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY'] = ''; os.environ['OFFLINE'] = '1'; from backend.main import _main; sys.exit(_main(['backend.main', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', '8000']))

configurations.name: verdict-frontend-mock
configurations.//: The frontend with NO backend: VITE_MOCK=1 serves every endpoint from src/mocks fixtures, so the whole UI is developable and demoable with the API down and zero LLM spend. Verified with the API stopped: a scripted run streams to a verdict and the chat answers with citations that resolve.
